summary: Extends the WebDAV MKCOL method so a client can create collections (folders) of types other than a plain one, and set properties on them in the same request. This makes it easier to create things like calendars or address books. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Normally you can ask a server only for a plain folder. This lets you ask for a special kind of folder, like a photo album, and label it right away, all in one request.

questions: what is extended mkcol in webdav
how to create a collection with properties in webdav
